sources.label: Official Sandro size guide (Woman - Ready-to-wear; Woman - Tops, Sweaters, Jackets, cm)

audit: Old /en/size-guide not the guide; it is /en/size-guide/size-guide.html (div grid, no <table>; read by position). Ready-to-wear header 34-42 with Standard 0-4, XS-XL, Germany, Italy, UK/Ireland and US rows; body chart prints bust/waist/hip ranges in cm. 34 79/60/84 -> 80-84/62-66/88-92; 38 87/68/92 -> 88-92/70-74/96-100; 42 96/77/101 -> 96-100/78-82/104-108. EU field removed: the 34-42 header row is unlabelled (it stays as the size label; Germany 32-40 and Italy 38-46 are printed separately). Standard 0-4 not stored.
